title_en: Big Black Bear and Little Hedgehog Treasure Hunt
source_file: 大黑熊和小刺猬淘宝（4-8岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 清华
少儿
中国名家经典原创图画书乐读本
大黑熊和小刺猬
杨永青 / 绘
清华大学出版社

[P2] 大黑熊和小刺猬

杨永青

上海市浦东新区川沙镇人，擅长版画、中国画、图书插画，早年

作者简介

师从著名人物画家谢闲鸥先生，1952年—1987年历任华东青年出版社、中国青年出版社、中国少年儿童出版社美术编辑、编审。创作儿童图书220余册以及数千幅插画，20余种儿童画册以多国文字在海外出版发行。曾获全国少年儿童图书评奖美术一等奖、中国版画家协会“鲁迅奖章”、国际安徒生奖提名等诸多荣誉。获国务院妇女儿童协调委员会颁发的“有突出贡献的儿童工作者”和关心下一代工作委员会颁发的“先进个人”等称号。作品被中国美术馆等多家机构收藏。曾任文化部儿童文学艺术委员会委员、中国美术家协会儿童美术艺术委员会主任、中国版画家协会第一届理事以及其他社会兼职十余项。

[P3] 森林里有一只大黑熊，仗着自己个头大，经常欺负小动物。“黑熊大哥，你不应该欺负弱小的动物。”小刺猬说。“一边去，小东西，把我惹了，连你也打！”大黑熊无法无天地说。

“放开我，放开我！”小兔子在半空中挣扎道。

大黑熊碰见小兔子，一把扯起小兔子的耳朵：“哈哈，这可不是耳朵，这就是两片芭蕉叶！”

[P4] 大黑熊和小刺猬

“小毛驴，快过来！”大黑熊放走小兔子，看见旁边经过的小毛

[P5] 驴喊道，还一把抓住了他的尾巴，‘让你跑！这哪里是尾巴，这就是一根绳子！哈哈！’
‘放开我，放开我！’小毛驴使劲用后腿踢大黑熊。
‘服不服？服不服？’大黑熊骑在小毛驴身上得意洋洋地问。
‘竟然敢踢本大王！哼！’大黑熊一把将小毛驴推倒在地。

[P6] “不回答就是不服气！”大黑熊一屁股坐在小毛驴身上。小毛驴疼得都流泪了。

[P7] “臭刺猬，看我不教训你！”说着，大黑熊跑到小刺猬跟前，想把小刺猬压扁。

“让你使坏！”小刺猬跳起来，用身上的刺扎向大黑熊的屁股。

“你个大坏蛋！”小刺猬跑过来说，“就知道欺软怕硬！有本事你去打大胖虎和小黑牛！”

[P8] “啊！我的屁股！疼死啦！”大黑熊张开大嘴喊叫道。
“你快下来，快下来！”大黑熊对小刺猬说道。

[P9] “不下来，不下来！”小刺猬高兴地说，“让你尝尝被教训的滋味！
大黑熊想用手把小刺猬拔下来，小刺猬一缩，大黑熊的爪子碰到了小刺猬的刺，拔不下来了。

[P10] “啊！疼死啦！我的手！我的屁股！”大黑熊朝天大叫。
大黑熊又疼又累，垂头丧气地说：“小刺猬，你饶了我吧！”

[P11] 小刺猬说：“那你得答应我，以后不许再欺负小动物们了！”“我答应你！”大黑熊回答。
小刺猬从大黑熊的屁股上跳下来：“你可要说话算话，要不然我加倍惩罚你。”“我错了，以后再也不欺负小动物了。”大黑熊再次保证。

[P12] 大黑熊揉着自己被扎的屁股一瘸一拐地回家了。他后来欺负过小动物们吗？嗯，反正我们大森林报社再也没有听说过。
full_text_en:
[P1] Tsinghua
Children's
Classic Original Picture Books by Chinese Masters
Big Black Bear and Little Hedgehog
Illustrated by Yang Yongqing
Tsinghua University Press

[P2] Big Bear and Little Hedgehog

Yang Yongqing

From Chuansha Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. Skilled in printmaking, Chinese painting, and book illustration. Early years

Author's Introduction

Studied under the renowned portrait painter Mr. Xie Xianou. From 1952 to 1987, served as art editor and reviewer at East China Youth Publishing House, China Youth Publishing House, and China Children's Publishing House. Created over 220 children's books and thousands of illustrations, with more than 20 children's picture books published overseas in multiple languages. Won the First Prize for Art in the National Children's Book Awards, the "Lu Xun Medal" from the China Printmakers Association, and was nominated for the Hans Christian Andersen Award, among other honors. Received the title of "Outstanding Children's Worker" from the State Council's Women and Children's Coordination Committee and "Advanced Individual" from the Committee for Caring for the Next Generation. Works are collected by institutions such as the National Art Museum of China. Served as a member of the Children's Literature and Art Committee of the Ministry of Culture, Director of the Children's Art Committee of the China Artists Association, First Council Member of the China Printmakers Association, and held over ten other social positions.

[P3] In the forest, there was a big black bear who, relying on his large size, often bullied small animals. "Big Bear Brother, you shouldn't bully weak little animals," said the hedgehog. "Get away, you little thing! If you annoy me, I'll beat you too!" the black bear said recklessly.

"Let me go, let me go!" the little rabbit struggled in mid-air.

The big black bear met the little rabbit, grabbed the rabbit's ears, and laughed: "Ha ha, these aren't ears at all—they're two banana leaves!"

[P4] Big Black Bear and Little Hedgehog

"Little donkey, come here quickly!" The big black bear let go of the little rabbit and saw the little donkey passing by nearby.

[P5] The donkey shouted, and grabbed his tail, 'Let you run! This is not a tail, it's a rope! Haha!'
'Let me go, let me go!' The little donkey kicked hard with his hind legs at the big black bear.
'Submit? Submit?' The big black bear asked proudly, riding on top of the little donkey.
'Daring to kick the king! Hmph!' The big black bear pushed the little donkey to the ground.

[P6] "Not answering means you're not convinced!" The big black bear sat down on the little donkey. The little donkey was in so much pain that he started crying.

[P7] "You stinky hedgehog, just wait till I teach you a lesson!" Saying that, Big Black Bear ran up to Little Hedgehog, intending to flatten him.

"You'll pay for this!" Little Hedgehog jumped up and stuck his spines into Big Black Bear's behind.

"You big bully!" Little Hedgehog ran over and said, "You only pick on the weak! If you're so tough, go fight Big Fat Tiger and Little Black Ox!"

[P8] "Ah! My bottom! It hurts so much!" the big black bear shouted with his mouth wide open.
"Get down, get down quickly!" the big black bear said to the little hedgehog.

[P9] "Not coming down, not coming down!" the little hedgehog said happily, "Let you taste the flavor of being taught a lesson!"
Big Black Bear tried to pull the little hedgehog off with his hand, but the little hedgehog curled up, and Big Black Bear's claws touched the hedgehog's spines and couldn't pull him off.

[P10] "Ah! It hurts so much! My hand! My bottom!" the big black bear shouted towards the sky.
The big black bear, sore and tired, hung his head and said, "Little hedgehog, please spare me!"

[P11] The hedgehog said, "Then you must promise me, you will never bully the little animals again!" "I promise!" the big black bear replied.
The hedgehog jumped down from the big black bear's behind: "You must keep your word, or I'll punish you twice as much." "I was wrong, I will never bully little animals again." The big black bear promised once more.

[P12] The big black bear rubbed his stung bottom and limped home. Did he bully the little animals afterward? Well, we at the Great Forest News Agency never heard of it again.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《大黑熊和小刺猬》的封面，展示了书名、作者、出版社信息以及大黑熊和小刺猬的插图。
[P2] 本页为绘本《大黑熊和小刺猬》的作者简介页，展示了作者杨永青的照片及其生平、成就和艺术经历。
[P3] 本页描绘了大黑熊欺负小动物的情景：它先是被小刺猬劝阻，随后抓住小兔子的耳朵戏弄，小兔子在空中挣扎求救。
[P4] 大黑熊抓着小兔子的耳朵戏弄它，随后放走小兔子，转而叫住路过的小毛驴。
[P5] 大黑熊抓住小毛驴的尾巴戏弄它，小毛驴奋力踢踹反抗，大黑熊将其按倒在地并得意地嘲讽。
[P6] 大黑熊将小毛驴按倒在地并坐在其身上，小毛驴因疼痛而流泪。
[P7] 大黑熊威胁要教训小刺猬，小刺猬勇敢反抗，用身上的刺扎向大黑熊的屁股，并斥责其欺软怕硬。
[P8] 大黑熊被小刺猬用刺扎了屁股，疼得大叫，并命令小刺猬下来。
[P9] 小刺猬骑在大黑熊的背上，得意地宣告要让大黑熊尝尝被教训的滋味；大黑熊试图用手将小刺猬拔下来，但因碰到刺而无法成功。
[P10] 大黑熊被小刺猬的刺扎得又疼又累，痛苦地大叫并请求小刺猬饶了他。
[P11] 小刺猬要求大黑熊承诺不再欺负小动物，大黑熊答应后，小刺猬跳下并再次强调要说话算话，大黑熊再次保证改正错误。
[P12] 大黑熊被小刺猬扎了屁股后一瘸一拐地回家，故事以大森林报社未再听说他欺负小动物作结，暗示其已改正错误。
